name: shadow-resume-assistant
description: 影子简历助手 - 本地优先的 AI 简历生成与修改工具

scripts.lint: pnpm -r lint && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff check backend tests
scripts.format: pnpm -r format && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff format backend tests
scripts.verify:package: pwsh -NoProfile -File tests/windows/verify_package.ps1 -Installer "output/installers/影子简历助手 Setup 0.2.0.exe"
scripts.test:all: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm -r build
